plan.title: Reverse auction rejects invalid delivery location

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event as a buy/reverse auction.
Select the reverse/buy auction template before adding line items.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Attempt to enter a non-plant value in the delivery-location dropdown; the step records that no matching option is available.
Assert that the invalid free-text delivery location was not retained.
